sentences.text: Benedict Timothy Carlton Cumberbatch CBE -LRB- born 19 July 1976 -RRB- is an English actor who has performed in film , television , theatre and radio .	CBE	Commander of the Order of the British Empire	Timothy Carlton	Timothy Carlton
He is the son of actors Timothy Carlton and Wanda Ventham .	Timothy Carlton	Timothy Carlton	Wanda Ventham	Wanda Ventham

Cumberbatch graduated from the University of Manchester and continued his training at the London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art , obtaining a Master of Arts in Classical Acting .	University of Manchester	University of Manchester	London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art	London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art

He first performed at the Open Air Theatre , Regent 's Park in Shakespearean productions and made his West End debut portraying George Tesman in Richard Eyre 's revival of Hedda Gabler in 2005 .	Shakespearean	Shakespearean	West End	West End theatre	Richard Eyre	Richard Eyre	Hedda Gabler	Hedda Gabler

Since then he has starred in the Royal National Theatre productions After the Dance -LRB- 2010 -RRB- and Frankenstein -LRB- 2011 -RRB- .	Royal National Theatre	Royal National Theatre	After the Dance	After the Dance (play)	Frankenstein	Frankenstein (2011 play)
In 2015 , he played William Shakespeare 's Hamlet at the Barbican Theatre .	William Shakespeare	William Shakespeare	Hamlet	Hamlet	Barbican Theatre	Barbican Centre

Cumberbatch 's television work includes appearances in Silent Witness -LRB- 2002 -RRB- and Fortysomething -LRB- 2003 -RRB- before playing Stephen Hawking in the television film Hawking in 2004 .	Silent Witness	Silent Witness	Fortysomething	Fortysomething (TV series)	Stephen Hawking	Stephen Hawking	Hawking	Hawking (2004 film)
He has starred as Sherlock Holmes in the series Sherlock since 2010 .	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock	Sherlock (TV series)
He has also headlined Tom Stoppard 's adaptation of Parade 's End -LRB- 2012 -RRB- and The Hollow Crown : The Wars of the Roses -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	Tom Stoppard	Tom Stoppard

In film , he has starred in Amazing Grace -LRB- 2006 -RRB- as William Pitt the Younger , Star Trek Into Darkness -LRB- 2013 -RRB- as Khan , 12 Years a Slave -LRB- 2013 -RRB- as William Prince Ford , The Fifth Estate -LRB- 2013 -RRB- as Julian Assange and The Imitation Game -LRB- 2014 -RRB- as Alan Turing .	Amazing Grace	Amazing Grace (2006 film)	William Pitt the Younger	William Pitt the Younger	Star Trek Into Darkness	Star Trek Into Darkness	Khan	Khan Noonien Singh	12 Years a Slave	12 Years a Slave (film)	William Prince Ford	William Prince Ford	The Fifth Estate	The Fifth Estate (film)	Julian Assange	Julian Assange	The Imitation Game	The Imitation Game	Alan Turing	Alan Turing
From 2012 to 2014 , through voice and motion capture , he played the characters of Smaug and the Necromancer in The Hobbit film series .	motion capture	motion capture	Smaug	Smaug	Necromancer	Sauron

Cumberbatch portrays the Marvel Comics character Dr. Stephen Strange in the Marvel Cinematic Universe , first appearing in the film Doctor Strange -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	Dr. Stephen Strange	Doctor Strange	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange (film)

Cumberbatch has received numerous awards and nominations for acting including three Laurence Olivier Award nominations , winning Best Actor in a Play for Frankenstein .	Frankenstein	Frankenstein (2011 play)	numerous awards and nominations	List of awards and nominations received by Benedict Cumberbatch	Laurence Olivier Award	Laurence Olivier Award	Best Actor in a Play	Laurence Olivier Award for Best Actor	Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor

He has also received four Primetime Emmy Award nominations , winning Outstanding Lead Actor in a Miniseries or a Movie for Sherlock .	Sherlock	Sherlock (TV series)	Primetime Emmy Award	Primetime Emmy Award	Outstanding Lead Actor in a Miniseries or a Movie	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Miniseries or a Movie

His performance in The Imitation Game earned him an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor .	The Imitation Game	The Imitation Game	Academy Award nomination	87th Academy Awards	Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor

In addition , he has received six BAFTA nominations , five Screen Actors Guild Award nominations and two Golden Globe Award nominations among others .	BAFTA	British Academy of Film and Television Arts	Screen Actors Guild Award	Screen Actors Guild Award	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award
In 2014 , Time magazine included him in its annual Time 100 as one of the `` Most Influential People in the World '' .	Time	Time (magazine)

He was appointed a CBE by Queen Elizabeth II in June 2015 for his services to the performing arts and to charity .	CBE	Commander of the Order of the British Empire	Queen Elizabeth II	Queen Elizabeth II
